description.text: Grants [Attach Ice with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Ice)], [Apex Spinning Edge Ability Tracker] and [Apex Spinning Edge Level]

description.name: Attach Ice with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Ice)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Spinning Edge (0~2), removed after using Apex Spinning Edge two times

description.name: Apex Spinning Edge Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Spinning Edge level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Ice abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Ice)]

description.name: Apex Spinning Edge Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Spinning Edge level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Celes (Ice)]
